I Loved my 1st 6 jars of Tallow Honey Balm...healed my psoriasis, and kept it away for the most part. My fine lines and wrinkles faded and the compliments on my glowing radiant skin were coming every time I stepped out. I recently ordered 2 more jars and the lavender soap. The Tallow Balm didn't arrive in the nice pretty packaged box like the 1st 6...they were wrapped in bubble wrap🫤...but I just knew it was the same...well to my surprise...they don't feel NOTHING like the ones before...whatever is in these jars are greasy...no Im not using too much, same as before. This tallow also doesn't absorb it sits on top of my skin...whereas the others absorbed within a few hours. Needless to say, Im very disappointed in this batch, not sure I'll order again as I've done more research and found others I'd be willing to try. The LAVENDER SOAP....WENT IN THE TRASH!!! I used it the 1st time...it burned so bad I had to immediately put the tallow balm on to soothe the burn. I thought maybe it was just ne so I had my husband try it, without telling him my experience, he said he liked the scent, lather, and feel...then said, "Dod it burn your skin? Because it burned mine for a little bit." So then I knew it wasn't just me and my skin. Besides that, the bars are small and will probably wither away within a week of daily use. This is definitely NOT the product I raved about to family and friends and even gave as gifts. Now Im not sure what to tell them about my last order...but I'll be honest, and just tell them my experience and they can decide on whether to order more when the ones I gave them run out. I'll update about others I find if they're better than my last order. I won't order again due to  buyers remorse. I almost think they suck you in with the good stuff and pretty packaging...then slip you the bad batches when you reorder...I hope that's NOT true...just my 1st thought.
